name: eu-public-procurement
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU public procurement law. Covers the Public Contracts Directive (2014/24/EU), Utilities Directive (2014/25/EU), Concessions Directive (2014/23/EU), Defence & Security Procurement Directive (2009/81/EC), and the Remedies Directives (89/665/EEC, 92/13/EEC, as amended by 2007/66/EC). Includes eForms Regulation (2019/1780), procurement procedures (open, restricted, competitive dialogue, innovation partnership, negotiated), thresholds, selection and exclusion criteria, MEAT award criteria, framework agreements, dynamic purchasing systems, standstill period, contract modifications, remedies (interim measures, set-aside, contract ineffectiveness, damages, alternative penalties), green and social procurement, reserved contracts, in-house exception, and cross-references to competition law and State aid.
author: ANTON Legal Team
